text: “Well, Monsieur Student,” growled the policeman. “What do you come and complain to me for?” “If you don’t chain him I’ll take him,” shouted the policeman. “What’s that to me, mon capitaine?” “Wha—t! Isn’t that bull-dog yours?” “If it was, don’t you suppose I’d chain him?” The officer glared for a moment in silence, then deciding that as he was a student he was wicked, grabbed at the dog, who promptly dodged. Around and around the flower-beds they raced, and when the officer came too near for comfort, the bull-dog cut across a flower-bed, which perhaps was not playing fair.
